name: compact-handoff
description: Replaces the engine's compaction with a subagent's handoff, and measures whether it can be one

live.title: Live
live.description: Off, it rehearses and the engine still compacts. On, it answers the event and the engine's summariser never runs.

dataDir.title: Data directory
dataDir.description: Where handoffs, rows and transcripts are kept. Empty uses ~/.claude/compact-handoff.

model.title: Model
model.description: The model the commitments pass runs on, an alias (haiku) or a full id. Empty uses the session's.

maxChars.title: Absolute ceiling (characters)
maxChars.description: Overrides the two below. 0 leaves them in charge. Never clamped: setting it is a deliberate act.

maxFraction.title: Context share
maxFraction.description: The share of the context window a handoff may take. Empty uses 0.25; anything outside (0, 1] falls back to it.

maxTokens.title: Token ceiling
maxTokens.description: The most a handoff may be whatever the window. 0 uses 150000; clamped to 200000.

restoreFiles.title: Restored files
restoreFiles.description: How many files the summariser may have restored after the handoff. 0 uses 5.

restoreFileChars.title: Per-file ceiling
restoreFileChars.description: The most of one restored file that comes back, in characters. 0 uses 20000.

restoreTotalChars.title: Restored total ceiling
restoreTotalChars.description: The most all restored files may add together, in characters. 0 uses 100000.

seamTimeoutMs.title: Seam timeout (ms)
seamTimeoutMs.description: How long one raised seam tool may run before the compaction goes on without it. 0 uses 90000.

subagents.title: Answer subagent compactions
subagents.description: Off, a subagent's compaction is passed through with a row saying so. On, it is answered like any other.

refresh.title: Fallback handoff
refresh.description: Keeps a fallback handoff on disk for sessions a fork cannot serve (headless).

refreshMs.title: Refresh gap (ms)
refreshMs.description: Shortest gap between two refreshes, and never sooner than 20 new messages. 0 uses 600000.
